g.title: ICML 2024 DeLVM asks whether we really need all that scale
g.desc: icml 2024 delvm asks whether really need all — do we really need 3B parameters and 400B visual tokens
g.text: DeLVM asks whether all that scale is really necessary.

g.title: Large vision models trained by autoregression promise a single generalist model
g.desc: large vision models trained autoregression promise single generalist many visual tasks — images and annotations encoded into one 1D token sequence
g.text: Images and annotations are encoded into a
single 1D sequence, then predicted token by
token — like a language model for vision.

g.desc: authors show two simple classical ideas augmentation knowledge distillation let compact model reach strong performance
